The company plans to deploy custom connectors across development, test, and production environments.

options.text: Manually rebuild the agents in each environment.

questions.explanation:
Managed solutions are intended for production deployment and help prevent direct changes to deployed components. Power Platform solutions package components for transport between environments and can include custom connectors; Copilot Studio agents are managed and deployed across environments by using solutions.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses a Microsoft Foundry agent that summarizes customer feedback and suggests products to customers. The agent accesses data from multiple knowledge sources.  
  
Users report slow agent response times.  
  
Telemetry indicates that the agent frequently hits its token-usage limit.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that reduces token usage without reducing the quality of generated responses.  
  
What should you recommend?

options.text: Reduce the number of knowledge sources used by the agent.
Reconfigure the prompts to limit the amount of retrieved content from the knowledge sources.
Lower the maximum token usage limit for the responses.

questions.explanation:
Chunk documents during indexing so retrieval returns smaller, relevant passages rather than entire or oversized documents. In RAG and agentic retrieval, retrieved passages are included in the model input; appropriate chunking helps meet input-token limits and prevents truncation while retaining relevant grounding content.

**Learn more:** [Chunk large documents for RAG and vector search in Azure AI Search](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/vector-search-how-to-chunk-documents) · [Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and indexes in Microsoft Foundry](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/concepts/retrieval-augmented-generation?view=foundry-classic)

questions.question:
A company intends to deploy a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that analyzes historical business data to predict customer behavior.  
  
The data is presently stored in an Azure SQL database, flat files, APIs, and logs.  
  
You need to organize the data into a format that Copilot Studio can use as a knowledge source.  
  
What should the solution include?
questions.explanation:
Azure AI Search creates a searchable index over enterprise content and is supported by Microsoft Copilot Studio as a knowledge source. It provides the retrieval layer needed to organize heterogeneous content for agent grounding, rather than merely storing the data.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add Azure AI Search as a knowledge source - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/knowledge-azure-ai-search)

questions.question: What should be configured for the custom AI agent?
questions.explanation:
Generative orchestration selects topics, tools, knowledge sources, and other agents using their descriptions and the user’s intent. It supports conversational routing without relying on authored trigger phrases, and can select connected agents based on their descriptions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Orchestrate agent behavior with generative AI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/advanced-generative-actions) · [Set topic triggers - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-triggers)

questions.question: What should be recommended to help the CTO select a prebuilt agent?

questions.explanation:
Microsoft 365 Copilot for Sales provides Outlook capabilities to summarize email threads and generate reply drafts, while its Microsoft 365 Copilot meeting-preparation experience supplies insights from CRM opportunity data. These capabilities cover email summarization, suggested replies, and CRM-informed meeting preparation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Sales agent FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-sales-copilot/sales-m365-copilot-faq) · [FAQs for customer communication feature in Outlook and Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-sales-copilot/faqs-customer-communication)

Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
A classic Microsoft Dataverse workflow provides rule-based process automation; it does not provide generative AI capabilities to summarize Outlook email threads, create suggested replies, or generate meeting-preparation summaries enriched with CRM data. Microsoft’s Copilot and Sales agent capabilities provide those Outlook and Dynamics 365-integrated features.\
\
**Learn more:** [Agents, Copilot, and AI capabilities in Dynamics 365 apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/copilot/ai-get-started) · [Boost sales efficiency with CRM-enriched email summaries in Outlook](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-sales-copilot/email-summary-premium)

questions.question:

Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Microsoft 365 Copilot agent template is a starting point for building a declarative agent; it does not, on its own, deliver the required Outlook email-thread summaries and suggested replies together with meeting-preparation summaries grounded in Dynamics 365 CRM data. Those capabilities require the appropriate built-in Outlook Copilot and Dynamics/Sales integration, or an agent specifically configured with the necessary CRM connection and instructions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Templates for agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/agent-templates-overview) · [Microsoft 365 Copilot application card](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-application-card)

options.text: Modify Solution1 to randomly generate emails for different traits.

questions.explanation:
System instructions can steer an Azure OpenAI model’s behavior and add explicit safety and fairness constraints.
